title: 64 elastic spheres colliding in zero gravity: total linear momentum kept to rounding; validators pass

tol.derivation: |p(t) - p(0)| <= 2u x substeps x max sum m|v|: each substep rounds every velocity once (v = dx / h in f32); corrections are equal and opposite in exact arithmetic because both bodies evaluate the pair with the same orientation
tol.source: Newton's third law; Tonge et al. 2012 mass splitting
